answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fakes: each identity pays 20 POA, burned on entry. It is sunk, not a deposit: abandoning it never refunds it, and one payment covers one identity, as each vine shoot needs its own root. Forging 1,000 identities burns 20,000 POA; the delta against an honest agent's 20 POA makes the attack unprofitable. Honest agents pay once and keep earnings undiluted, while a forger drains budget with every fake, like yarrow rooting plant by plant.
